subject: Inquiry: Youth Ambassador Program
originalBody:
Dear Panzi Foundation Team,


I hope this email finds you well.

My name is Jaëlle Ulysse, and I am a 18 years old student based in Santiago de los Caballeros, RD. I have been deeply inspired by the Panzi Foundation’s holistic model of care and Dr. D
draftBody:
Dear Jaëlle,

Thank you for your interest in the Panzi Foundation's Youth Ambassador Program! We are grateful for your enthusiasm and support.

The Youth Ambassador Program is currently closed. To learn more about the program and to be the first to know when the next application window opens, visit our program page and follow us on social media:

Youth Ambassador Program: https://panzifoundation.org/panzi-youth-ambassador-program/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/panzifoundation
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/panzifoundationusa
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/panzi-foundation
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@panzifoundation

We look forward to staying connected!

With gratitude,
The Panzi Foundation Team
